types.name: AcousticMaterial
types.summary: Surface acoustics for reflection, scattering and transmission.

types.name: AcousticPath
types.summary: Acoustic simulation result. Physics/Steam workers publish this at a frame boundary.

types.name: AcousticPortal
types.summary: An opening (door, window, archway) connecting two zones. An empty zone name is outdoors.

types.name: AcousticSource
types.summary: Per-source acoustic behaviour, alongside AudioSource. Optional: sources without it use AcousticSource::default().

types.name: AcousticsSettings
types.summary: World-wide propagation constants, stored in project/world settings.

types.name: AcousticSurface
types.summary: Acoustic surface of static geometry or a collider. The physics ray adapter maps hit bodies to this component; absent components read as generic.

types.name: AnimAsset
types.summary: A stable authoring record holding imported data or a controller source graph.

types.name: AnimationClipSetParams
types.summary: Replace animation clip keys.

types.name: AnimationControllerSetParams
types.summary: Replace an animation controller graph.

types.name: AnimationCreateParams
types.summary: Create one animation asset (skeleton, clip, controller or procedural setup).

types.name: AnimationIkSetParams
types.summary: Replace procedural animation contact chains.

types.name: AnimationMotionDatabaseSetParams
types.summary: Replace pose-search database configuration.

types.name: AnimationPropertySetParams
types.summary: Edit one schema-addressed field of an animation record.

types.name: AnimationRagdollSetParams
types.summary: Replace a physical animation ragdoll profile.

types.name: AnimationRigSetParams
types.summary: Replace semantic humanoid bone bindings.

types.name: AnimationSkeletonSetParams
types.summary: Replace animation skeleton source.

types.name: Animator
types.summary: Skeletal animation for this entity's MeshRenderer.model, compiled to an ara-anim program: the controller document when set, else an idle state and a move state whose 1D blend tree is driven by the entity's ground speed, cross-faded at moveThreshold.

types.name: AnimBlendSample
types.summary: A blend sample with a stable child-node identity.

types.name: AnimComparison
types.summary: A typed parameter comparison.

types.name: AnimCondition
types.summary: One transition predicate; all conditions on a transition must match.

types.name: AnimController
types.summary: Canonical controller source, lowered to an immutable program by Controller.

types.name: AnimJoint
types.summary: A joint in parent-before-child order, with stable importer identity. Reflected as AnimJoint (the physics Joint component owns the bare name); documents never name it, so the rename needs no document migration.

types.name: AnimMatrix
types.summary: An explicitly imported inverse-bind matrix, in column-major order.

types.name: AnimNode
types.summary: A typed animation graph node. The compiler validates fields for each kind.

types.name: AnimNodeKind
types.summary: Runtime pose operation represented by an authoring graph node.

types.name: AnimParameter
types.summary: A typed parameter declaration, addressed by its stable map key.

types.name: AnimParameterKind
types.summary: A schema-registered gameplay parameter type.

types.name: AnimState
types.summary: A state selecting a pose graph and its normalized phase clock.

types.name: AnimTransform
types.summary: A local affine transform; rotations use XYZW quaternions.

types.name: AnimTransition
types.summary: A state transition. Serialized list order defines deterministic priority.

types.name: Atlas
types.summary: Canonical atlas metadata; the immutable pixel payload lives in the asset cache.

types.name: Attenuation
types.summary: Distance rolloff model, evaluated in meters.

types.name: AudioBus
types.summary: One bus (category) in the mixer tree. AudioSource.bus names it.

types.name: AudioDuck
types.summary: Sidechain ducking: another bus's level pulls this bus down (dialogue over music).

types.name: AudioEffectCodec
types.summary: Codec for resident sound effects; streamed audio always uses Opus.

types.name: AudioGraphAddParams
types.summary: Adds an operation node.

types.name: AudioGraphParamParams
types.summary: Edits a parameter's default, range or documentation.

types.name: AudioGraphRemoveParams
types.summary: Removes a node or parameter and every reference to it.

types.name: AudioGraphRenameParams
types.summary: Renames a parameter or node, keeping its identity, wiring and canvas position.

types.name: AudioGraphSetInputParams
types.summary: Sets one input of a node, or a graph output, to a literal or a reference.

types.name: AudioGraphSource
types.summary: Plays a procedural audio graph (an ara-audio-graph graph document, domain audio) from this entity, spatialized and attenuated by its AudioSource (whose clip stays empty). Gameplay writes parameters and bumps triggers; the audio presenter forwards changes sample-accurately at the next control frame.

types.name: AudioGraphTextParams
types.summary: Replaces the graph with edited .audiograph text; surviving names keep their IDs.

types.name: AudioImportSettings
types.summary: Audio sidecar settings, validated identically by authoring commands and workers.

types.name: AudioImportUse
types.summary: Audio use selects resident effects or streamed music/dialogue.

types.name: AudioListener
types.summary: Presentation listener, usually copied from the local player's camera component.

types.name: AudioMixerSettings
types.summary: Mixer-wide settings (one record per mixer document).

types.name: AudioMixState
types.summary: A named mix (combat, explore, menu): per-bus gain offsets reached over fade seconds.

types.name: AudioSource
types.summary: Declarative sound intent. Playback cursors and decoder state are presentation only.

types.name: BehaviorRenameParams
types.summary: Renames a state, variable or query, rewriting every reference.

types.name: BehaviorStateAddParams
types.summary: Adds an empty state.

types.name: BehaviorStateRemoveParams
types.summary: Removes a state, its children and transitions that target them.

types.name: BehaviorTextParams
types.summary: Replaces the behaviour with DSL text, keeping IDs of surviving names.

types.name: BehaviorTransitionParams
types.summary: Adds a transition.

types.name: BehaviorVarParams
types.summary: Sets (or clears) a variable's default.

types.name: BoneRole
types.summary: Anatomical roles shared by Mixamo, UE Mannequin and Unity Humanoid rigs.

types.name: Brain
types.summary: Runs a behaviour on this entity (authoring).

types.name: Camera
types.summary: A viewpoint looking along the entity's local -Z axis. The lowest priority wins.

types.name: Camera2d
types.summary: Orthographic view. Pixel mode uses integer zoom and nearest texel sampling.

types.name: Camera2dSetParams
types.summary: Complete typed component authoring update.

types.name: CaptureAudioParams
types.summary: Parameters for the offline capture_audio job, run outside the human's audio engine.

types.name: Cell
types.summary: One grid/layer partition, with a scene plus optional per-entity scene files.

types.name: ChainData
types.summary: Canonical chain setup, addressed by stable skeleton joint IDs.

types.name: CharacterController
types.summary: Predicted capsule movement: slopes, stairs, moving platforms, crouching and pushing.

types.name: CharacterController2d
types.summary: Kinematic capsule character: slopes, steps, ground snapping and pushing. The entity needs no RigidBody2d/Collider2d; the controller owns its capsule.

types.name: CharacterInput
types.summary: Per-tick character intent: replay this input exactly once before the rigid-body step.

types.name: CharacterInput2d
types.summary: Per-tick character intent, read exactly once by each boundary. Gameplay writes it before the physics system; it is not cleared, so held input repeats.

types.name: CharacterMotion
types.summary: Character support and stance mirrored at every fixed boundary.

types.name: CharacterMotion2d
types.summary: Character support mirrored at every fixed boundary.

types.name: ClipData
types.summary: An editable clip. Cook this once in the asset worker, never on a frame thread.

types.name: Collider
types.summary: Collision geometry, material, layer and trigger settings.

types.name: Collider2d
types.summary: Collision geometry, material, layer and trigger settings for a RigidBody2d.

types.name: ColliderFromModelParams
types.summary: Derive a collider from an imported model or the entity's MeshRenderer selection.

types.name: ColliderKind
types.summary: Primitive or cooked geometry selection. Cooked geometry is resolved by the asset worker.

types.name: ColliderKind2d
types.summary: Convex 2D geometry selection; 2D never reuses the 3D shape vocabulary.

types.name: ComponentAddParams
types.summary: Parameters of component.add.

types.name: ComponentRemoveParams
types.summary: Parameters of component.remove.

types.name: ControlAudioParams
types.summary: Schema-discoverable audio.control parameters for an existing presentation voice.

types.name: CookPreset
types.summary: Encoding quality is an explicit cook input, independent of the execution budget. New imports default to Balanced; projects and individual textures can select HQ.

types.name: Curve
types.summary: An animation curve addressing the same property path as the inspector.

types.name: DocCreateParams
types.summary: Parameters of doc.create.

types.name: DocDeleteParams
types.summary: Parameters of doc.delete.

types.name: Entity
types.summary: An entity in a scene or prefab. Components are stored inline under their type names; a prefab instance stores prefab plus overrides instead.

types.name: EntityCreateParams
types.summary: Parameters of entity.create.

types.name: EntityDeleteParams
types.summary: Parameters of entity.delete.

types.name: EntityInspectParams
types.summary: Parameters of entity.inspect.

types.name: EntityReparentParams
types.summary: Parameters of entity.reparent.

types.name: Environment
types.summary: Procedural sky radiance and camera exposure. The first in stable-ID order wins.

types.name: ExposureMode
types.summary: How the camera exposes the scene (a post-process volume's exposure override).

types.name: Flipbook
types.summary: Tick-driven flipbook state, wholly contained in an ECS component.

types.name: FlipbookFrame
types.summary: One deterministic flipbook frame.

types.name: FlipbookSetParams
types.summary: Complete typed component authoring update.

types.name: FoliageCreateParams
types.summary: Foliage source terrain.

types.name: FoliageEraseParams
types.summary: Stable record deletion for erasing manual strokes/rules/zones.

types.name: FoliageExcludeParams
types.summary: Exclusion insertion parameters.

types.name: FoliageExclusion
types.summary: Circular exclusion zone, applied identically to procedural and manual foliage.

types.name: FoliageHeader
types.summary: Terrain dependency for a foliage document.

types.name: FoliagePaint
types.summary: One manual brush gesture, retained for deterministic regeneration and undo.

types.name: FoliagePaintParams
types.summary: One manual brush stroke.

types.name: FoliageRule
types.summary: Seeded procedural placement rule, evaluated on workers in global cell space.

types.name: FoliageRuleParams
types.summary: Rule insertion/replacement parameters.

types.name: FoliageSpecies
types.summary: Vegetation/prop family used by render extraction and impostor selection.

types.name: FollowCamera
types.summary: Third-person orbit rig: places this entity behind target, steered by Look.

types.name: Foot
types.summary: A foot chain and its anatomical sole-up direction.

types.name: FootSettings
types.summary: Ground-contact setup, serialized in the same animation asset as its chains.

types.name: GraphComment
types.summary: A graph comment, stored only in the editor section.

types.name: GraphDirection
types.summary: Direction relative to the owning node.

types.name: GraphEdge
types.summary: A directed connection with its own stable document record ID.

types.name: GraphEditor
types.summary: Nonsemantic editor state, excluded entirely from semantic_hash.

types.name: GraphEndpoint
types.summary: An addressed socket; port identity is scoped to the node.

types.name: GraphGroup
types.summary: A visual group; membership never changes execution.

types.name: GraphHeader
types.summary: Domain metadata, kept apart from editor state.

types.name: GraphNode
types.summary: A versioned node; opaque payloads survive unavailable plugins unchanged.

types.name: GraphPort
types.summary: A stable named, nominally typed socket. Domains interpret ty.

types.name: GridLayout
types.summary: Tile coordinate layout; hex is axial and pointy-topped.

types.name: HeightFog
types.summary: Exponential height fog lit by the sun, the sky and local lights (volumetric shafts where shadows cut the beams). Density halves every falloff × ln 2 metres above baseHeight. The first entity in ID order wins.

types.name: IkSetup
types.summary: Canonical procedural rig setup; goal values are fixed-tick gameplay inputs.

types.name: ImportConfigureParams
types.summary: Parameters of import.configure.

types.name: ImportInitializeParams
types.summary: Parameters of import.initialize.

types.name: ImportProjectConfigureParams
types.summary: Parameters of import.project.configure; reflected in the inspector and MCP.

types.name: ImportSettings
types.summary: Declarative importer configuration, stored as the single i_settings record.

types.name: Interpolation
types.summary: Interpolation between consecutive keys.

types.name: Joint
types.summary: Joint on a body; connection zero anchors to the world. Anchors/axes are world-space.

types.name: JointKind
types.summary: Joint primitive implemented by the backend.

types.name: JointLimit
types.summary: Anatomical angular bounds, in radians around a unit bind-local axis.

types.name: JointTrack
types.summary: Sparse local transform channels for one joint; empty channels use bind pose.

types.name: L10nExtractParams
types.summary: Source-scan request. Sources are supplied by the host; no arbitrary filesystem IO.

types.name: L10nFindMissingParams
types.summary: Source locale for parity checks against the current batch document.

types.name: L10nFontFace
types.summary: Explicit font resource; never depends on installed OS fonts.

types.name: L10nLocaleConfig
types.summary: One locale's configuration, stored as l_config in its localization document.

types.name: L10nParamKind
types.summary: Parameter types shared by messages, generated bindings and translation jobs.

types.name: L10nProvenance
types.summary: Reproducible origin of a generated translation; no secrets belong here.

types.name: L10nPutParams
types.summary: Validated insertion/replacement params used by machine-applicable fixes.

types.name: L10nRemoveParams
types.summary: Record addressed removal of an obsolete localization message.

types.name: L10nSourceKind
types.summary: Source language scanned for localization candidates.

types.name: L10nStatus
types.summary: Human review state, independent of whether the text can be displayed.

types.name: L10nStringEntry
types.summary: A mergeable message record; its stable record ID survives translation changes.

types.name: Layer
types.summary: Independently loaded and visible data layer, such as art, night or quest state.

types.name: Light
types.summary: A light at the entity's world position. Edits apply live in play.

types.name: Light2d
types.summary: Point light for an explicitly lit sprite; Z provides normal-map elevation.

types.name: Light2dSetParams
types.summary: Complete typed component authoring update.

types.name: LightKind
types.summary: How a light emits.

types.name: LimitKind
types.summary: Angular constraint relative to the local bind rotation.

types.name: LinkKind
types.summary: How agents traverse an off-mesh link. Animation reads it from NavAgentState.traversal (an intent), never through a call.

types.name: LocomotionClip
types.summary: One clip of a locomotion blend and the ground speed it represents.

types.name: MatchConfig
types.summary: Cook-time feature schema. Feature order is six floats per bone (position/velocity), three root-velocity floats, then six floats per horizon (position/facing).

types.name: MatchNode
types.summary: Graph-node search settings. The clip field references a cooked motion database.

types.name: MaterialBudgetParams
types.summary: Sets an explicit material specialization budget.

types.name: MaterialConnectParams
types.summary: Rewires an AST argument or output, preserving the destination edge's identity.

types.name: MaterialGraphParams
types.summary: Applies an edited graph projection as the same material AST.

types.name: MaterialInstance
types.summary: A saved material instance; all authoritative overrides are document fields.

types.name: MaterialInstanceClearParams
types.summary: Removes a saved override, restoring the definition default.

types.name: MaterialInstanceSetParams
types.summary: Edits one saved material instance override.

types.name: MaterialLiteralParams
types.summary: Replaces an expression with a typed constant.

types.name: MaterialOutputParams
types.summary: Identifies a domain output field.

types.name: MaterialParameterParams
types.summary: Identifies a material parameter.

types.name: MaterialPreset
types.summary: Named surface materials with Steam Audio's published values.

types.name: MaterialRenameParams
types.summary: Renames an authored value while retaining its graph identity and layout.

types.name: MaterialTextParams
types.summary: Replaces the text view, retaining layout for surviving semantic IDs.

types.name: MaterialTypeParams
types.summary: Changes a node's declared type (also used by type annotation fixes).

types.name: MeshRenderer
types.summary: Draws geometry at the entity's interpolated world transform.

types.name: MeshSettings
types.summary: Deterministic geometry cook policy.

types.name: MeshShape
types.summary: Built-in procedural geometry for gray-box levels.

types.name: MixerBusSetParams
types.summary: Creates or replaces a complete mixer category.

types.name: ModelColliderMode
types.summary: Geometry used by a model-derived collider.

types.name: MotionType
types.summary: How a rigid body moves; kinematic targets are runtime intents.

types.name: MotionType2d
types.summary: How a rigid body moves; kinematic bodies follow their written pose.

types.name: MotorGains
types.summary: Position and orientation spring gains in SI units.

types.name: MusicNext
types.summary: A weighted follow-up for horizontal resequencing.

types.name: MusicSegment
types.summary: A playable section with synchronized stems on one tempo map.

types.name: MusicSegmentSetParams
types.summary: Create or replace a music segment with stems and tempo map.

types.name: MusicSettings
types.summary: Music-wide settings (one record).

types.name: MusicSettingsSetParams
types.summary: Music-wide starting segment, intensity, layer fade and deterministic seed.

types.name: MusicSource
types.summary: Plays a .music document's interactive score (segments, transitions, intensity layers) from this entity, non-spatial. Presentation intent: gameplay writes intensity and segment; the audio presenter follows them.

types.name: MusicStem
types.summary: A synchronized layer (stem) of a segment, faded in by intensity.

types.name: MusicStinger
types.summary: A one-shot played on top of the music, aligned to the grid.

types.name: MusicStingerSetParams
types.summary: Create or replace a grid-aligned music stinger.

types.name: MusicSync
types.summary: Where a transition or stinger may land.

types.name: MusicTempo
types.summary: A tempo and meter that applies from bar until the next change.

types.name: MusicTransition
types.summary: How a requested change of segment lands. An empty from matches any segment.

types.name: MusicTransitionSetParams
types.summary: Create or replace a synchronized music transition.

types.name: NavAgent
types.summary: Dimensions, speed and permitted areas of one navigation agent.

types.name: NavAgentType
types.summary: A named agent type: its own baked mesh (dimensions) and traversal costs. Agents select it through NavAgent.profile == profile.

types.name: NavArea
types.summary: Area label and cost policy for the collision-geometry producer and query filters.

types.name: NavLink
types.summary: Authored off-mesh connection in world space (jump, ladder or scripted passage).

types.name: NavMeshSurface
types.summary: Authored raw-geometry navigation surface; its derived mesh is content-addressed.

types.name: NavObstacle
types.summary: Dynamic obstacle: an axis-aligned box centred on the entity's NavPosition. Carve/Area changes publish after NavConfig::rebake_latency_ticks; until then (and always for Avoid) agents avoid it locally.

types.name: Notify
types.summary: A discrete animation notify, identified independently of its display name.

types.name: ObstacleMode
types.summary: How the navigation reacts to a dynamic obstacle.

types.name: OverrideRevertParams
types.summary: Parameters of prefab.override.revert.

types.name: OverrideSetParams
types.summary: Parameters of prefab.override.set.

types.name: PaintCell
types.summary: A tile-paint sample in a stroke transaction.

types.name: Perceiver
types.summary: An AI's senses: a sight cone with peripheral vision, hearing and memory.

types.name: PhysicalMode
types.summary: Fixed-tick physical-animation mode.

types.name: PhysicalState
types.summary: Complete future-affecting blend state. Store this in the character's ECS component.

types.name: Physics2dSetParams
types.summary: A complete rigid body or character, validated as one unit.

types.name: PhysicsId
types.summary: Stable simulation identity; nonzero and unique within a physics world.

types.name: PhysicsPose
types.summary: Resolved world-space pose in meters. Hierarchy/scale resolution runs before physics.

types.name: PhysicsPose2d
types.summary: World-space 2D pose, written back by the solver at every completed boundary.

types.name: PlayAudioParams
types.summary: Schema-discoverable audio.play parameters; protocol resolves asset and entity handles.

types.name: PlayerControl
types.summary: Drives this entity's CharacterController from Move, Sprint and Jump, relative to its camera rig's yaw.

types.name: PostModule
types.summary: The group of settings one PostOverride entry changes.

types.name: PostOverride
types.summary: One group of settings a post-process volume overrides: pick the group in module, then tick the properties to change. Unticked properties are left to lower-priority volumes and the defaults.

types.name: PostProcessVolume
types.summary: A region whose post-processing overrides blend in as the camera approaches and enters it. Volumes apply in ascending priority (ties in entity ID order); each property one overrides moves toward its value by the volume's weight at the camera. Properties no volume overrides keep the engine defaults. Scenes saved with the former PostProcess component load as one global volume that overrides everything.

types.name: PrefabInstantiateParams
types.summary: Parameters of prefab.instantiate.

types.name: PrimitiveMaterialOverride
types.summary: One native material graph/instance replacing a selected model primitive's material.

types.name: ProjectImportSettings
types.summary: Defaults inherited by import sidecars which do not specify a preset.

types.name: ProjectSetMainParams
types.summary: Parameters of project.setMain.

types.name: ProjectSettings
types.summary: Project marker represented as a record so project changes share history and undo.

types.name: PropertySetParams
types.summary: Parameters of property.set.

types.name: QualitySetting
types.summary: Rendering quality. auto picks from the GPU: High on ray-tracing GPUs (Medium below 8 GiB of video memory), Low without ray tracing. Epic is never automatic.

types.name: RagdollBone
types.summary: One capsule and parent constraint in a canonical powered-ragdoll asset.

types.name: RagdollProfile
types.summary: Canonical body/constraint/motor configuration, cooked at import or spawn boundaries.

types.name: RenderSettings
types.summary: Project-wide rendering settings, stored under rendering in ara.project.json. A player's --quality flag overrides quality for that run.

types.name: Retarget
types.summary: Bone identity and reference pose used by a retargeting tool.

types.name: ReverbZone
types.summary: A room or space with its own reverb. The listener's zone drives the room reverb; sources in other zones reach the listener through portals.

types.name: RigBone
types.summary: One semantic bone binding, using a stable importer joint ID.

types.name: RigidBody
types.summary: Rigid-body authoring settings; simulation state is written to pose and velocity.

types.name: RigidBody2d
types.summary: Rigid-body authoring settings; simulation state is written to pose and velocity.

types.name: RigMap
types.summary: Canonical humanoid definition. Partial rigs are legal; ambiguity is never guessed.

types.name: RotationKey
types.summary: A unit quaternion key at an exact integer clip time.

types.name: SavePersistDeclaration
types.summary: Reflected persistence flag. This extension descriptor references the Schema DB; it does not duplicate fields, defaults, versions or migration implementations.

types.name: SaveStorage
types.summary: Storage class referenced by a persistence declaration, independent of replication.

types.name: ScalarKey
types.summary: A scalar key for a property curve.

types.name: SkeletonData
types.summary: An imported skeleton, ordered for a linear model-space traversal.

types.name: SkyAtmosphere
types.summary: A physical sky and aerial perspective lit by the scene's directional light. The sun's elevation sets the time of day; without this component the scene uses its Environment gradient. The first entity in ID order wins.

types.name: Sprite
types.summary: A batched sprite with optional normal-mapped 2D illumination.

types.name: SpriteRegion
types.summary: Atlas rectangle and authoring geometry, in source pixels.

types.name: SpriteSetParams
types.summary: Complete typed component authoring update.

types.name: Stimulus
types.summary: Something perceivers can see and remember (players, corpses, thrown objects).

types.name: StopAudioParams
types.summary: Schema-discoverable audio.stop parameters; this stops presentation only.

types.name: StreamedWorld
types.summary: Streams a .world's cells into play around the players (ara-runtime-world). Put it on one entity of the level scene; the cell documents stay out of the projection and arrive at tick boundaries. With a Terrain, navigation then follows the resident TerrainChunks.

types.name: Terrain
types.summary: Puts a .terrain heightfield (and its .foliage scatter) in play: rendered by the landscape renderer, walkable for navigation, solid where TerrainChunks exist.

types.name: TerrainChunk
types.summary: Collision for one terrain tile (grid coordinates of the level's Terrain). Author these in world cells to stream collision with the cells.

types.name: TerrainCoord
types.summary: Integer X/Z address in a terrain's fixed grid.

types.name: TerrainCreateParams
types.summary: Grid creation parameters for an empty terrain document.

types.name: TerrainDab
types.summary: One brush dab; the stroke command groups all dabs into one transaction.

types.name: TerrainHeader
types.summary: Stable terrain grid settings; adjacent tiles duplicate their shared border.

types.name: TerrainImportParams
types.summary: Imports one immutable source tile, preserving subsequent layer edits.

types.name: TerrainLayer
types.summary: A non-destructive layer; order followed by stable ID defines composition.

types.name: TerrainLayerParams
types.summary: A non-destructive layer to insert.

types.name: TerrainLayerSetParams
types.summary: Change layer settings while retaining its gesture history.

types.name: TerrainOperation
types.summary: Operation performed by one recorded brush gesture.

types.name: TerrainStroke
types.summary: A complete gesture, retained as source rather than destructive tile snapshots.

types.name: TerrainStrokeParams
types.summary: A whole gesture, including every dab; do not issue one transaction per mouse sample.

types.name: TerrainTile
types.summary: Sparse touched-tile delta: a base payload and ordered references to gestures.

types.name: TextureSettings
types.summary: Declarative texture import settings.

types.name: TextureUsage
types.summary: Semantic texture usage selects transfer functions, mip filtering and BC format.

types.name: TileCell
types.summary: A signed source-cell address. Reflected as TileCell (world partition cells own Cell).

types.name: TileColliderSource2d
types.summary: Ownership marker for generated colliders, separate from gameplay body state.

types.name: TileCollidersParams
types.summary: Tile collider generation request.

types.name: TileDefinition
types.summary: A tile's visual, terrain, collision and lighting definition.

types.name: TileEraseParams
types.summary: An eraser stroke.

types.name: TileFillParams
types.summary: Bounded flood fill of edge-connected cells matching the seed's tile.

types.name: TileLayer
types.summary: One map layer with stable identity, source cells and independent painter order.

types.name: Tilemap
types.summary: Canonical text source for a tilemap. Binary chunks are derived cache products.

types.name: TilemapSetParams
types.summary: Complete typed component authoring update.

types.name: TilePaintParams
types.summary: A stroke of explicitly addressed tile samples.

types.name: TileRule
types.summary: First matching rule wins. Masks use GridLayout::neighbors bit order; a neighbor "matches" when its tile's definition has the rule's terrain.

types.name: TileRuleParams
types.summary: Applies all terrain rules to a layer in one transaction.

types.name: ToneMapping
types.summary: The display transform that compresses scene radiance into the screen's range.

types.name: Transform
types.summary: Position, rotation and scale of an entity relative to its parent.

types.name: TransformLookAtParams
types.summary: Parameters of transform.lookAt.

types.name: TransformSetParams
types.summary: Parameters of transform.set.

types.name: TranslateParams
types.summary: Generation request and completed provider output, committed as one undoable job.

types.name: TranslationItem
types.summary: One provider input; the source fingerprint makes late responses safe to reject.

types.name: TranslationRequest
types.summary: Provider-independent generation job, suitable for a background worker or MCP host.

types.name: TranslationResponse
types.summary: Provider response; no provider SDK or credentials enter the localization crate.

types.name: UiSource
types.summary: Lossless UI source; persistence writes native XML through SourceDocument.

types.name: UiSourceApplyParams
types.summary: Replaces a UI document's native markup through revision-checked source ops.

types.name: VectorKey
types.summary: A vector key at an exact integer clip time.

types.name: Vehicle
types.summary: Four-wheel engine/automatic-gearbox vehicle, using S6's stable defaults.

types.name: VehicleInput
types.summary: Replayable driver intent consumed every fixed tick.

csharp.name: AcousticMaterial
csharp.summary: Surface acoustics for reflection, scattering and transmission.

csharp.name: AcousticPortal
csharp.summary: An opening (door, window, archway) connecting two zones. An empty zone name is outdoors.

csharp.name: AcousticSource
csharp.summary: Per-source acoustic behaviour, alongside AudioSource. Optional: sources without it use AcousticSource::default().

csharp.name: AcousticSurface
csharp.summary: Acoustic surface of static geometry or a collider. The physics ray adapter maps hit bodies to this component; absent components read as generic.

csharp.name: Animation
csharp.summary: Typed inputs to an entity's authored native animation controller.

csharp.name: Animator
csharp.summary: Skeletal animation for this entity's MeshRenderer.model, compiled to an ara-anim program: the controller document when set, else an idle state and a move state whose 1D blend tree is driven by the entity's ground speed, cross-faded at moveThreshold.

csharp.name: Attenuation
csharp.summary: Distance rolloff model, evaluated in meters.

csharp.name: Audience
csharp.summary: Recipients of a replicated field.

csharp.name: AudioGraphSource
csharp.summary: Plays a procedural audio graph (an ara-audio-graph graph document, domain audio) from this entity, spatialized and attenuated by its AudioSource (whose clip stays empty). Gameplay writes parameters and bumps triggers; the audio presenter forwards changes sample-accurately at the next control frame.

csharp.name: AudioListener
csharp.summary: Presentation listener, usually copied from the local player's camera component.

csharp.name: AudioSource
csharp.summary: Declarative sound intent. Playback cursors and decoder state are presentation only.

csharp.name: Behaviour
csharp.summary: A per-entity object with Unity-like ergonomics that holds no authoritative state. Declare sealed partial class Door : Behaviour with [Property] public partial float OpenAngle { get; set; }: the generator backs each property with a column of the generated Door data component, so the value is saved, replicated and survives reload. Other instance fields must be TransientAttribute caches (ARA0101).

csharp.name: Brain
csharp.summary: Runs a behaviour on this entity (authoring).

csharp.name: Caller
csharp.summary: Who may send a networked command.

csharp.name: Camera
csharp.summary: A viewpoint looking along the entity's local -Z axis. The lowest priority wins.

csharp.name: Camera2d
csharp.summary: Orthographic view. Pixel mode uses integer zoom and nearest texel sampling.

csharp.name: CharacterController
csharp.summary: Predicted capsule movement: slopes, stairs, moving platforms, crouching and pushing.

csharp.name: CharacterController2d
csharp.summary: Kinematic capsule character: slopes, steps, ground snapping and pushing. The entity needs no RigidBody2d/Collider2d; the controller owns its capsule.

csharp.name: CharacterInput
csharp.summary: Per-tick character intent: replay this input exactly once before the rigid-body step.

csharp.name: CharacterInput2d
csharp.summary: Per-tick character intent, read exactly once by each boundary. Gameplay writes it before the physics system; it is not cleared, so held input repeats.

csharp.name: CharacterMotion
csharp.summary: Character support and stance mirrored at every fixed boundary.

csharp.name: CharacterMotion2d
csharp.summary: Character support mirrored at every fixed boundary.

csharp.name: Collider
csharp.summary: Collision geometry, material, layer and trigger settings.

csharp.name: Collider2d
csharp.summary: Collision geometry, material, layer and trigger settings for a RigidBody2d.

csharp.name: ColliderKind
csharp.summary: Primitive or cooked geometry selection. Cooked geometry is resolved by the asset worker.

csharp.name: ColliderKind2d
csharp.summary: Convex 2D geometry selection; 2D never reuses the 3D shape vocabulary.

csharp.name: Color
csharp.summary: A linear RGBA color (the schema's color type). Defaults to opaque white in the schema.

csharp.name: ColorPickerAttribute
csharp.summary: Edits a linear RGB(A) value with the engine's colour picker.

csharp.name: CommandAttribute
csharp.summary: Declares a gameplay command: a static partial class with public static CommandResult Execute(ref CommandContext ctx, Entity target, ref C component, ...). Plain parameters become the params type agents and tools call it with; ref/in component parameters bind to the target entity's components. Commands are synchronous and capture no managed state, so they are prediction- and undo-safe.

csharp.name: CommandContext
csharp.summary: What a CommandAttribute command sees: the tick, the caller, a deterministic Rng, structural Commands and cues. A ref struct, so commands cannot capture it in lambdas or keep it past the call.

csharp.name: CommandResult
csharp.summary: The outcome of a command: Ok, or a rejection made with Reject. A rejected command leaves the world unchanged.

csharp.name: Commands
csharp.summary: Structural changes (spawn, despawn, add, remove) and cues, buffered and applied by the host at the next sync point in a deterministic order. Systems take it as a ref Commands parameter; behaviours and commands get one from their context.

csharp.name: ComponentAttribute
csharp.summary: Declares a blittable component stored in engine ECS columns. Apply to a partial struct; the source generator registers it in the Schema DB (name, fields, units, ranges, docs), so it appears in reflection.json and agent tools.

csharp.name: CueAttribute
csharp.summary: Declares a presentation cue (sound, VFX trigger) that commands and systems emit with Cue(...). Cues are reported to the host and never change simulation state.

csharp.name: DefaultAttribute
csharp.summary: The schema default of a field: a number, bool or string, or a vector's components.

csharp.name: EngineComponentAttribute
csharp.summary: Marks a component generated from the Rust Schema DB (engine-owned; do not apply by hand).

csharp.name: EngineComponents
csharp.summary: Engine components in stable binding order.

csharp.name: Entity
csharp.summary: A generation-checked handle to an entity in the ECS world: the engine's Entity::to_bits (a complemented index in the low 32 bits, the generation in the high 32). A despawned entity's handle never becomes valid again, so a stale handle reads as missing instead of aliasing a new entity. Use IsAlive or Has; there is no overloaded null equality.

csharp.name: Environment
csharp.summary: Procedural sky radiance and camera exposure. The first in stable-ID order wins.

csharp.name: ExampleAttribute
csharp.summary: An example params object (JSON) for a command, shown to agents and in docs.

csharp.name: ExecuteOn
csharp.summary: Where a networked command runs.

csharp.name: ExposeAttribute
csharp.summary: Network exposure of a CommandAttribute command (enforced by the netcode layer).

csharp.name: ExposureMode
csharp.summary: How the camera exposes the scene (a post-process volume's exposure override).

csharp.name: Flipbook
csharp.summary: Tick-driven flipbook state, wholly contained in an ECS component.

csharp.name: FlipbookFrame
csharp.summary: One deterministic flipbook frame.

csharp.name: FollowCamera
csharp.summary: Third-person orbit rig: places this entity behind target, steered by Look.

csharp.name: FormerlySerializedAsAttribute
csharp.summary: A former field name; files using it are renamed on read (Unity's attribute, same meaning).

csharp.name: Frame
csharp.summary: One presented frame (variable rate), passed to Behaviour.OnFrame.

csharp.name: GridLayout
csharp.summary: Tile coordinate layout; hex is axial and pointy-topped.

csharp.name: HeaderAttribute
csharp.summary: Inspector group heading for this field and the ones after it.

csharp.name: HeightFog
csharp.summary: Exponential height fog lit by the sun, the sky and local lights (volumetric shafts where shadows cut the beams). Density halves every falloff × ln 2 metres above baseHeight. The first entity in ID order wins.

csharp.name: IComponent<TSelf>
csharp.summary: Implemented by the generated code of every component struct, so lookups need no reflection (AOT-safe).

csharp.name: ICue<TSelf>
csharp.summary: Implemented by the generated code of every CueAttribute struct.

csharp.name: IResource<TSelf>
csharp.summary: Implemented by the generated code of every ResourceAttribute struct.

csharp.name: Input
csharp.summary: Replayable player actions at the current fixed tick. Behaviours and commands only.

csharp.name: Interpolate
csharp.summary: How remote views smooth a replicated field between snapshots.

csharp.name: Joint
csharp.summary: Joint on a body; connection zero anchors to the world. Anchors/axes are world-space.

csharp.name: JointKind
csharp.summary: Joint primitive implemented by the backend.

csharp.name: Light
csharp.summary: A light at the entity's world position. Edits apply live in play.

csharp.name: Light2d
csharp.summary: Point light for an explicitly lit sprite; Z provides normal-map elevation.

csharp.name: LightKind
csharp.summary: How a light emits.

csharp.name: LinkKind
csharp.summary: How agents traverse an off-mesh link. Animation reads it from NavAgentState.traversal (an intent), never through a call.

csharp.name: LocomotionClip
csharp.summary: One clip of a locomotion blend and the ground speed it represents.

csharp.name: Log
csharp.summary: Logging to the host console and log.

csharp.name: MaterialPreset
csharp.summary: Named surface materials with Steam Audio's published values.

csharp.name: MaxAttribute
csharp.summary: An inclusive upper bound.

csharp.name: MeshRenderer
csharp.summary: Draws geometry at the entity's interpolated world transform.

csharp.name: MeshShape
csharp.summary: Built-in procedural geometry for gray-box levels.

csharp.name: MinAttribute
csharp.summary: An inclusive lower bound.

csharp.name: MissingComponentException
csharp.summary: Thrown when an entity lacks a component that code asked for.

csharp.name: MotionType
csharp.summary: How a rigid body moves; kinematic targets are runtime intents.

csharp.name: MotionType2d
csharp.summary: How a rigid body moves; kinematic bodies follow their written pose.

csharp.name: Movement
csharp.summary: Fixed-tick controls for native physics characters.

csharp.name: MusicSource
csharp.summary: Plays a .music document's interactive score (segments, transitions, intensity layers) from this entity, non-spatial. Presentation intent: gameplay writes intensity and segment; the audio presenter follows them.

csharp.name: NavAgent
csharp.summary: Dimensions, speed and permitted areas of one navigation agent.

csharp.name: NavAgentType
csharp.summary: A named agent type: its own baked mesh (dimensions) and traversal costs. Agents select it through NavAgent.profile == profile.

csharp.name: NavArea
csharp.summary: Area label and cost policy for the collision-geometry producer and query filters.

csharp.name: NavLink
csharp.summary: Authored off-mesh connection in world space (jump, ladder or scripted passage).

csharp.name: NavMeshSurface
csharp.summary: Authored raw-geometry navigation surface; its derived mesh is content-addressed.

csharp.name: NavObstacle
csharp.summary: Dynamic obstacle: an axis-aligned box centred on the entity's NavPosition. Carve/Area changes publish after NavConfig::rebake_latency_ticks; until then (and always for Avoid) agents avoid it locally.

csharp.name: Navigation
csharp.summary: Server-authoritative goals for authored NavAgent components; paths remain in ECS.

csharp.name: ObstacleMode
csharp.summary: How the navigation reacts to a dynamic obstacle.

csharp.name: Perceiver
csharp.summary: An AI's senses: a sight cone with peripheral vision, hearing and memory.

csharp.name: PhysicsId
csharp.summary: Stable simulation identity; nonzero and unique within a physics world.

csharp.name: PhysicsPose
csharp.summary: Resolved world-space pose in meters. Hierarchy/scale resolution runs before physics.

csharp.name: PhysicsPose2d
csharp.summary: World-space 2D pose, written back by the solver at every completed boundary.

csharp.name: PlayerControl
csharp.summary: Drives this entity's CharacterController from Move, Sprint and Jump, relative to its camera rig's yaw.

csharp.name: PostModule
csharp.summary: The group of settings one PostOverride entry changes.

csharp.name: PostOverride
csharp.summary: One group of settings a post-process volume overrides: pick the group in module, then tick the properties to change. Unticked properties are left to lower-priority volumes and the defaults.

csharp.name: PostProcessVolume
csharp.summary: A region whose post-processing overrides blend in as the camera approaches and enters it. Volumes apply in ascending priority (ties in entity ID order); each property one overrides moves toward its value by the volume's weight at the camera. Properties no volume overrides keep the engine defaults. Scenes saved with the former PostProcess component load as one global volume that overrides everything.

csharp.name: PrimitiveMaterialOverride
csharp.summary: One native material graph/instance replacing a selected model primitive's material.

csharp.name: PropertyAttribute
csharp.summary: Backs a Behaviour's partial property with an ECS column: the value lives in the behaviour's generated data component, so it is saved, replicated and survives reload.

csharp.name: QueryAttribute
csharp.summary: Turns a static void Run(ref A a, in B b, in Tick t) method into a chunk-batched system. ref component parameters are writes, in parameters reads; the read/write sets go to the scheduler, so non-conflicting systems run in parallel. Optional parameters: Entity, in Tick, ref Rng, ref Commands, and ResourceAttribute structs.

csharp.name: RangeAttribute
csharp.summary: Inclusive numeric bounds (Unity's [Range], same meaning).

csharp.name: ReplicateAttribute
csharp.summary: Network replication of a field (codecs and interpolation stay in the engine).

csharp.name: ResourceAttribute
csharp.summary: Declares a world singleton (game rules, tuning). Systems take it as an in or ref parameter; behaviours and commands use Resource.

csharp.name: ReverbZone
csharp.summary: A room or space with its own reverb. The listener's zone drives the room reverb; sources in other zones reach the listener through portals.

csharp.name: RigidBody
csharp.summary: Rigid-body authoring settings; simulation state is written to pose and velocity.

csharp.name: RigidBody2d
csharp.summary: Rigid-body authoring settings; simulation state is written to pose and velocity.

csharp.name: Rng
csharp.summary: Deterministic random numbers (PCG-XSH-RR). Seeds come only from the context: the session seed, the tick, and a stream key such as the system and entity, so results are identical across machines, thread counts and chunk splits. Never use System.Random in simulation code (ARA0200).

csharp.name: SimulationAttribute
csharp.summary: Marks simulation code (a type or the whole assembly): it must be deterministic, so ARA0200 rejects async, wall-clock time, System.Random, I/O and threads in it.

csharp.name: SkyAtmosphere
csharp.summary: A physical sky and aerial perspective lit by the scene's directional light. The sun's elevation sets the time of day; without this component the scene uses its Environment gradient. The first entity in ID order wins.

csharp.name: Sprite
csharp.summary: A batched sprite with optional normal-mapped 2D illumination.

csharp.name: Stimulus
csharp.summary: Something perceivers can see and remember (players, corpses, thrown objects).

csharp.name: StreamedWorld
csharp.summary: Streams a .world's cells into play around the players (ara-runtime-world). Put it on one entity of the level scene; the cell documents stay out of the projection and arrive at tick boundaries. With a Terrain, navigation then follows the resident TerrainChunks.

csharp.name: Terrain
csharp.summary: Puts a .terrain heightfield (and its .foliage scatter) in play: rendered by the landscape renderer, walkable for navigation, solid where TerrainChunks exist.

csharp.name: TerrainChunk
csharp.summary: Collision for one terrain tile (grid coordinates of the level's Terrain). Author these in world cells to stream collision with the cells.

csharp.name: Tick
csharp.summary: The fixed simulation tick that every system, behaviour and command sees.

csharp.name: TileColliderSource2d
csharp.summary: Ownership marker for generated colliders, separate from gameplay body state.

csharp.name: TileDefinition
csharp.summary: A tile's visual, terrain, collision and lighting definition.

csharp.name: TileLayer
csharp.summary: One map layer with stable identity, source cells and independent painter order.

csharp.name: TileRule
csharp.summary: First matching rule wins. Masks use GridLayout::neighbors bit order; a neighbor "matches" when its tile's definition has the rule's terrain.

csharp.name: Tilemap
csharp.summary: Canonical text source for a tilemap. Binary chunks are derived cache products.

csharp.name: ToneMapping
csharp.summary: The display transform that compresses scene radiance into the screen's range.

csharp.name: TooltipAttribute
csharp.summary: Inspector tooltip text; used as the field doc when there is no XML doc comment.

csharp.name: Transform
csharp.summary: Position, rotation and scale of an entity relative to its parent.

csharp.name: TransientAttribute
csharp.summary: A presentation-only cache on a Behaviour: not saved, not replicated, dropped on reload. Every other Behaviour instance field is an error (ARA0101).

csharp.name: UnitAttribute
csharp.summary: Physical unit of a numeric field, by schema symbol (see Units).

csharp.name: Units
csharp.summary: Unit symbols for UnitAttribute, as stored in the Schema DB.

csharp.name: Vehicle
csharp.summary: Four-wheel engine/automatic-gearbox vehicle, using S6's stable defaults.

csharp.name: VehicleInput
csharp.summary: Replayable driver intent consumed every fixed tick.

csharp.name: VehicleTelemetry
csharp.summary: Vehicle drivetrain and suspension state mirrored into ECS after each tick.

csharp.name: Velocity
csharp.summary: Authoritative velocity, synchronized at tick boundaries.

csharp.name: Velocity2d
csharp.summary: Authoritative velocity, synchronized at tick boundaries.

csharp.name: VisualEffect
csharp.summary: A GPU particle effect drawn at this entity. Presentation only: gameplay reads ara-vfx CPU events, never GPU particles. effect names a cooked library effect (campfire, sparks, depth_sparks, magic_swirl, smoke, muzzle_flash, rain, dust).

csharp.name: VolumeShape
csharp.summary: Where a post-process volume applies.

csharp.name: Wanderer
csharp.summary: Server-side AI: walks the navmesh to random points inside a box, pausing between.

csharp.name: WithAttribute<T>
csharp.summary: Restricts a QueryAttribute system to entities that also have T.

csharp.name: WithoutAttribute<T>
csharp.summary: Restricts a QueryAttribute system to entities without T.

csharp.name: World
csharp.summary: Random access to ECS data from behaviours and commands (which run with exclusive world access). Systems never use this: they declare their components as parameters so the scheduler can run them in parallel. References stay valid until the current callback returns; structural changes go through Commands.

csharp.name: ZoneShape
csharp.summary: Reverb zone volume shape.
